newsitem.title: UK: Halifax avg price of 2nd auction 732.8p/shr.
newsitem.headline: Halifax avg price of 2nd auction 732.8p/shr.

text.p: Halifax Plc said on Tuesday that the average price of its second auction of 9.75 million shares was 732.8 pence a share.
The range of prices was 727 pence to 737 pence, it said in a statement.
Halifax said in a statement that all valid bids above 728 pence were allocated in full while valid bids made at 727 pence, the lowest successful price, were allocated on a pro rata basis.
Halifax's brokers Merrill Lynch and Cazenove had auctioned 23 percent of its flotation shares on Friday to institutional investors.
On Monday the newly-floated company said the average price for the first auction of shares for members was 732.5 pence per share, in a range of 710 pence to 815 pence a share.
